grounding_profile_result.invariant: Admission failure never manufactures provenance or mutates semantic identity/kind/lifecycle merely to pass a profile.

codec_evaluation.question: Can frozen cove/1 structurally encode normalized pems/2 without contract reinterpretation?
proof_basis: COVE/1 envelope p is an opaque semantic/profile identifier.
COVE/1 core is domain-agnostic and uses only global string interning plus deterministic object-shape factoring.
COVE/1 encoded tags cover every JSON value class used by PEMS/2: null/boolean/number, string, array, object.
PEMS/2 changes semantic/schema vocabulary but introduces no new non-JSON structural value type.
Decoder semantic-profile support is independently dispatched after structural decode; unknown profile must fail closed.
Therefore pems/2 support changes the semantic validator set, not the frozen cove/1 structural contract.

acceptance_checks_defined: scoped grounding conformance for newly admitted material
lossless cove/1 structural round trip with p=pems/2
repeated candidate canonical bytes identical under jcs/1
dual-read profile dispatch and unknown-profile rejection
Steward admission of exact candidate bytes and governance closeout
unresolved_questions: Exact future cutover candidate bytes do not exist until a separately authorized candidate-generation tranche fixes one source canonical revision and generates the proposed pems/2 canonical artifact.
Grounding requirements for additional future proposition/admission classes may require new scoped profiles as evidence accumulates.
recommendation: Return to the Steward. Recommend eventual PEMS/2 canonical adoption using cove/1 + pems/2 + jcs/1 after a separately authorized exact-candidate generation and owner adoption gate. Do not create cove/2 absent a structural codec requirement.
